messages:
anya: quick flag - customer 'NorthField' reported seeing an extra "series" in the dashboard that belonged to another workspace. screenshots show workspace_id ws_zz12 inside the payload.

rob: which build/env?

anya: prod-eu, new rollout (route-mux sticky) at 2026-03-20T09:10Z. request: GET /api/console/dash/panels?panel=usage&range=6h with x-workspace-id: ws_nf01. response body had a series with workspace_id: ws_zz12.

kai: sounds like caching with stale backend metadata. we recently changed mux to include backend_metadata in the rpc response to speed rendering. maybe that got persisted into cached panel payloads.

anya: i pulled headers, server responded x-cache: HIT and x-cache-key: dash:panel:usage:mux=af_32:range=6h

rob: ops-bot, can you invalidate cache keys for mux affinity af_32 in prod-eu? also roll back the backend_meta emission flag.

ops-bot: invalidation queued (job inv-17799). toggling emit-backend-meta=false in prod-eu feature-flags.

release-bot: deploy tagged rollback-backend-meta emitted to prod-eu (id: rel-17799).

kai: follow-up: add assertion in cache write path to require explicit workspace_id when serializing cached payloads. i'll open PR with a short patch.

rob: also add telemetry counter cache.isolation.fail when cached.payload.workspace != request.workspace. we need an alert.

anya: confirmed customer no longer sees foreign series after invalidation. filing INC-2026-122 and will own RCA.

kai: PR#4499 incoming with assert + telemetry. will add an e2e that simulates two workspaces hitting same mux affinity.

rob: good. also audit any recent affinity-related changes last 48h for similar risks.

anya: closing thread, follow-ups in INC-2026-122 and PR#4499.
